facts.business: Laxmi Organic Industries Limited is primarily engaged in the business of manufacturing acetyl intermediates and specialty chemicals.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment (including capital work in progress and capital advances) and intangible assets

guidance_or_targets.statement: Target >1.5% reduction in energy consumption in the next year

The Company anticipates a progressive improvement in EBITDA margins and return on capital employed (ROCE), supported by stabilization of market conditions and benefits accruing from capacity expansion, process improvements, digital transformation, cost optimization, and pricing discipline.
